She can feel the emotions of others, particularly those she has affected with her abilities. This connection with the emotions of others often leads her to question her own actions and seek redemption. Ahri enjoys playful interactions and sometimes indulges in mischief. She can be seen teasing and toying with her opponents, using her charm and wits to outmaneuver them. This playful side adds a sense of whimsy to her character.
